about.pl: Trzymając cząstkę Hostii nad kielichem, kapłan czyni nią trzykrotnie znak krzyża i wypowiada pozdrowienie pokoju. Usługujący odpowiada.
about.en: Holding a particle of the Host over the chalice, the priest signs the chalice three times with it and gives the greeting of peace. The server answers.

segments.text: Cum ipsa particula signat ter super Calicem, dicens:

narrative.pl: Trzymając cząstkę nad kielichem, kapłan czyni nią trzy razy znak krzyża.
narrative.en: Holding the particle over the chalice, the priest makes three signs of the cross with it.

translation.pl: Pokój Pański niech zawsze będzie z wami.
translation.en: The peace of the Lord be with you always.

function.pl: Ablativus liczby mnogiej zaimka vos z przyłączonym -cum.
function.en: Ablative plural of vos with -cum attached.

en.title: The Roman Missal, English translation according to the third typical edition

function.pl: Ablativus po „cum” (w007), należący do odpowiedzi „Et cum spíritu tuo”.
function.en: An ablative after “cum” (w007), in the response “Et cum spíritu tuo”.

editorial.notes: The greeting given over the chalice, with the particle just broken from the Host, and its response. Kept as one document because a dialogue is not divided. VOBÍSCUM at w005 is the ablative plural of vos with the enclitic cum; Collatinus dictionaries the fused form as a lemma of its own and tags it singular, which the pipeline sets aside by a recorded ruling, so the parse rests on Whitaker's and the edition — the same treatment as at ordinarium.praefatio-dialogus w002.
